product_launches.description: Coinrule launched agent-based AI execution for stocks and ETFs, integrating with seven retail brokerage platforms so users can deploy AI trading agents across equities and ETFs via the existing interface.

overview_description.description: Coinrule is an automated trading platform designed to facilitate intelligent AI-driven investments across various investment platforms and asset classes. It empowers cryptocurrency investors to develop and evaluate automated trading strategies, allowing them to capitalize on market opportunities while safeguarding against unfavorable events. The platform was established with the goal of democratizing access to trading strategies and models, which have traditionally been exclusive to investment banks and hedge funds, making them available to all investors.

about_short_description.short_description: Coinrule is a fintech firm that specializes in the automation of cryptocurrencies, decentralized finance, exchange-traded funds, and stocks.

product.name: Coinrule Automated Trading Platform
product.description: A no-code platform for creating and running automated trading strategies across cryptocurrencies, stocks, and ETFs through connected exchanges, brokers, and blockchains.

identifier.value: Coinrule Strategy Builder and Bot Templates

product.name: Coinrule Strategy Builder and Bot Templates
product.description: A visual rule builder and library of more than 350 pre-built strategies for creating trading bots without programming, including DCA, grid, trend-following, stop-loss, and portfolio-rebalancing strategies.

product.name: Coinrule Backtesting and Demo Exchange
product.description: A strategy-testing environment that lets users evaluate trading rules with virtual funds and historical or live market data before connecting them to a live exchange or broker.

identifier.value: Coinrule MCP and AI Trading Automation

product.name: Coinrule MCP and AI Trading Automation
product.description: An integration based on the Model Context Protocol that allows compatible AI assistants to inspect portfolios and manage Coinrule strategies through natural-language instructions.

product.name: Coinrule Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for monitoring and managing Coinrule trading bots, creating rules, viewing portfolios, and receiving notifications on iOS and Android devices.
